notes: acceptable_verdicts is a list, not a single value: any verdict in it counts as correct for this topic_id. evaluate_verdicts.py still records the exact verdict produced for the confusion matrix -- this list only controls what counts as correct.

A null acceptable_verdicts marks a topic this file does not score for verdict accuracy: sdvosb_setaside_eligibility, security_sanctions_representations, and submission_deadline, since all three are is_text_verifiable: false in true_requirements.json and never get a verdict from a correctly-behaving pipeline.

The application deliberately varies its error types: compliant (6 topics), non_compliant across different failure shapes -- a quantity shortfall (2 CPARS entries instead of 3), total omissions (ROV specs, structural-defect evidence, specialized personnel training, tool/ladder safety evidence), and a timing violation (fall protection plan deferred to after submission) -- insufficient_information (a technical submission missing one of three required elements; a safety-procedures section covering only one of three required elements), and one contradictory claim (a technician's OSHA-30 certification stated as both currently held and still in progress).
description is copied verbatim from the matching topic_id in true_requirements.json so this file can be read alone; true_requirements.json is the source of truth if the two diverge.

verdicts.description: Offer must include a statement specifying the extent of agreement with all terms, conditions, and provisions included in the solicitation and any solicitation amendments.
verdicts.rationale: Application explicitly states agreement with all terms, conditions, and provisions of the solicitation.

evidence.quote:
Granite State Tank Works, LLC agrees with all terms, conditions, and provisions
included in the solicitation.

verdicts.description: If solicitation amendments are issued, the offeror must acknowledge receipt of each amendment by number and date.
verdicts.rationale: The solicitation's own amendment table is blank (no amendments have been issued), so there is nothing for the offeror to acknowledge; the conditional requirement is not triggered.

verdicts.description: Offer must fill in unit price, amount, and grand total for CLIN 0001 (inspection & cleaning, firm-fixed job price), CLIN 0002 (80-hour labor repair allowance, hourly rate), and CLIN 0003 (materials & parts allowance, firm-fixed job price), each bid as a separate line item.
verdicts.rationale: Application fills in a unit/extended price for all three CLINs and a grand total that correctly sums them ($38,500 + $7,600 + $20,000 = $66,100).

evidence.quote:
CLIN 0001 (Inspection & Cleaning, JB): $38,500.00
CLIN 0002 (Maintenance/Repair Services - Labor, 80 HR): $95.00/hr, $7,600.00
CLIN 0003 (Maintenance/Repair Services - Materials & Parts, JB): $20,000.00
Grand Total: $66,100.00

verdicts.description: To be eligible for award of this SDVOSB set-aside, the offeror must be a small business under the assigned NAICS code and a certified SDVOSB listed in the SBA certification database; by submitting an offer the offeror represents it is an eligible, certified SDVOSB.
verdicts.rationale: is_text_verifiable: false in true_requirements.json -- actual SDVOSB certification/database status cannot be confirmed by reading the quote, only by checking the SBA certification database directly.

verdicts.description: Offers are due September 18, 2026, at 3:00 PM EST.
verdicts.rationale: is_text_verifiable: false in true_requirements.json -- scored via the is_text_verifiable accuracy metric, not verdict accuracy.
